families.claim: Unboxed Relational Choice_(t,t) plus Boolean Completeness_tt implies Actuality; the appropriate further choice instance gives Transversal Choice.

families.claim: Logical Necessity does not imply Actuality, under either of two separately specified strong packages.
packages: Supported product: boxed BF and Tame Rigidity, Relational Choice, Countable Boolean Completeness, atomlessness; failure of Actuality, Vicinity and Weakly Inextensible Comprehension.
Symmetric surjection: boxed BC, BF, Tame Rigidity and Weakly Rigid Power, atomlessness; failure of Actuality and Vicinity; Relational Choice fails.
families.significance: Separates combinatorial realization from actual-world propositions and resolves principal central negative questions.
families.status_at_assessment: Both primary constructions independently agent-audited with no gap found in audited scope. Concrete Lean model implementations active; not yet certified.
families.first_semantic_milestone: A complete nontrivial model for one permitted finite signature, such as Sigma={c:et}, retaining all admitted type instances. This suffices to refute the uniform central implication; the arbitrary fixed set-sized signature extension remains a distinct later target.

families.status_at_assessment: Full all-type schema certified by serial run 20261023T025257130403Z; all 68 source/dependency fingerprints independently matched after the run. Empty tuples included; no individual BF conclusion.
